title: Chapter 674
paragraphs: Chapter 674
Episode 171. Under the Imperial Palace...(3)
Thanks to discovering and handling the tunnel of chaos beneath the Imperial Palace, the public sentiment toward Jin and Dante from the Empire pierced the sky once again.
Day after day, articles about this incident poured out.
Praises were coming from all over, so much so that there was no need for Dino Jägerlöwen to add strength to the public opinion, as always.
Deep down, the lords who had been harboring complaints about overworking Dante now harbored even more loyalty toward him.
If it hadn't been for Dante and Jin, no one would have discovered the imperial crisis.
Second Imperial Palace of Hairan.
Since the evacuation began, the Empire had been using this place as a temporary Imperial Palace.
After the long meeting that had just ended, Jin and his colleagues, King Owl of Nameless Assassins, and the best assassin Bizan were left in Dante's office.
"I'm sorry the meeting took so long, Lord Owl."
"No problem. We came too early."
Owl spoke in a low voice. His tired look, puffing on a cigarette with squinting eyes, was quite weary.
Those gathered in the office were fixating their gaze on the black lump on the table.
The object left after beheading the fake Yona.
Owl had seen it before.
"We assumed that we might have missed Yona, but... I never thought it would go into the Garden of Swords."
Nameless Assassins was referring to the black lump that the group was now observing as Yona's 'rampage trace.'
The traces of rampage started to be found very recently and, as you can tell from the name, it was a kind of chaos condensate left in place every time Yona ended her rampage.
After the Glick subjugation battle, the chaos Yona harbored reacted to the remnants of Glick and plagued her again.
As time passed, the period of rampage shortened, became more dangerous, and now it reached a level where it was impossible to hold Yona back even if the entire Nameless Assassins was clinging to her.
At Owl's nod, Bizan opened a box next to him.
In it were six traces of rampage, similar in shape to what they obtained from the basement of the Imperial Palace.
Having heard in advance that there were six more, the feeling of unease grew even deeper when they faced it directly with their own eyes.
The reason for the unease is none other than this.
According to Valeria's review of the records of the traces of rampage, the prophet was creating the fake Yona through those traces. Through the power of chaos.
"Lord Owl, how many traces of rampage did Nameless Assassins miss?"
"Three at least, more than five at most."

"That means there could be more than five remaining fakes. Furthermore, in the worst-case scenario... No, there's a high probability that additional traces of rampage are continually being generated. The ones we are missing."
Owl nodded heavily.
"Is there a possibility that Yona is completely entrapped in the Garden of Swords?"
"That won't be the case. When you beheaded the fake, we were in a state of tracking and battling the real Yona."
Owl spoke as he rolled up his right sleeve.
A long, dark scar was visible, a wound obtained while tracking Yona a few days ago.
There were no fatalities because the search party consisted only of Owl and the top assassins.
If Yona had targeted the top assassins first instead of Owl, Bizan wouldn't be standing here now.
"She seemed tormented, after nearly killing me. The child is now, compared to the fake you dealt with, infinitely more dangerous."
"Did Yona show signs of being brainwashed by the prophet?"

"You've seen it too, how immense the power of chaos that child possesses. And I've heard from Sir Chiron in the past that the chaos she holds is of a very special kind. I don't think the prophet can control it that easily."
"Father said such a thing."
"Yes. Is Sir Chiron's expedition still out of contact?"
"Yes, it is."
At Jin's matter-of-fact answer, Owl closed his eyes once. He too did not believe that Chiron and the expedition would have survived.
"As soon as the Yona matter is resolved, we will send people from Nameless Assassins."
"Thank you, Lord Owl."

"Anyway, putting aside whether the prophet can control Yona's chaos. Even if the current Garden of Swords is great, it will be difficult to catch her in a short period. Unlike us, they can create fakes just by getting these traces of rampage."
In terms of target tracking and assassination, Nameless Assassins had superior abilities to Runcandel before it was tainted by chaos.
Seeing as such Nameless Assassins has been unable to catch Yona for several years now, Owl was certain that the prophet would also be helpless.
"You said the last place you lost her was Akin."
The last place Nameless Assassins lost Yona is the Kingdom of Akin in the Rutelo Magic Federation.
This is where Jin destroyed the dark organization Tesing and obtained Multa's runes, Shuziel's magic book, and Jet.
"She's probably still in Akin, as the remaining search parties are not reporting anything special. Even if she left, she would still be within the Rutelo Magic Federation."
The further Yona's location was from Huphester, the better.
Especially now, thanks to the temporary alliance, they were in a position to receive help from Zipple.
However, unlike in Valeria's case, Jin didn't want to receive help from 'all of Zipple' if he could help it.
'The situation with Yona is different from the master...'
Valeria is a person necessary even to Zipple.
Therefore, they accepted Jin's unreasonable request just for receiving traces of magic.
But Yona was different.
'If possible, Zipple would want to remove Yona on this occasion.'
For now, because of the rampage, even Nameless Assassins cannot control her, but once she recovers, it is clear that Yona will be on Jin's side.
Therefore, from Zipple's standpoint, there was no reason to capture Yona alive.
There was plenty of justification to refuse even if Jin asked for her capture.
They could conclude that due to the rampage, civilians within Akin could be harmed, or because of Yona's martial prowess, capturing her is impossible.
Of course, if Yona is killed, they can threaten to break the alliance.
However, that would only result in gambling the fate of the entire world.
Owl had the same thoughts.

"We do need to accept Zipple's assistance, but my concerns precede. They have no reason to keep Yona alive, unlike us. However, if we don't notify Zipple, we'll inevitably face civilian casualties or situations where Zipple can take advantage, so honestly, it's frustrating."
"Has Yona ever caused a rampage and killed civilians... so far?"
At the weighty question, Owl met Jin's gaze.
"No."
"Really?"
"Yes, I swear. It seemed that Yona focused all her indiscriminate desire to kill on me and Nameless Assassins's assassins."
Whoo, Owl exhaled a puff of smoke from his cigarette.
"That's probably because she was thinking of you, the 12th."
Jin, who brushes down his chest.
Since meeting Jin, Yona hasn't killed people without reason.
She has always been wary of chaos, and her efforts are still valid now.
"What do you think is the best course of action?"
Owl asked this question, feeling a sense of despair.
He was on the verge of self-loathing for asking Jin about 'Nameless Assassins's' affairs, no matter how strong Jin might be.

"She hasn't undergone physical transformation yet, and considering she's resisting the chaos, she's not fully consumed either. We need to find her as quickly as possible, before she becomes unable to use the purification device."
"So, you mean it's better to accept Zipple's help, even at the risk of Yona being eliminated?"
"Yes. However, I don't intend to discuss this with the leaders of Zipple."
Owl's eyes narrowed.
"So, what's the plan?"
"I will seek the help of Tower Keeper Hedo and Sandra Zipple. Just those two. They would probably help find my sister without informing Zipple."

After all, Hedo and Sandra had already been asked to meet. They needed to examine Hedo's sword, which was presumed to be the entrance to the sixth tomb, and to fully convert them to the Vamel alliance.
Whether they could be trusted, or whether Sandra Zipple had that much authority, Owl didn't add to Jin's words.
Because he felt like he was seeing the younger Chiron in Jin.
Jin's words carried that much weight.
"Alright. Then we, Nameless Assassins, will start searching Akin again from now."
"Additionally, could you sneak the personnel who are not mobilized for the search for Yona into Huphester?"

"Let it be so. It doesn't seem like we can maintain our neutrality in this situation. Nameless Assassins officially joins the Vamel Alliance today. It's the right thing to do to step forward as it is the Alliance's affair. As soon as you give me the list of rescue targets, I'll send people."
"Thank you, Owl. I'll have Red Owl and his colleagues on standby, so please contact Tikan as soon as you find Yona."
Owl stood up from his seat and offered Jin a handshake.
"A few years ago, that young kid has grown to a point where he now stands above me. It's something your father couldn't achieve, so you should be very proud."
"Nameless Assassins is just a member of the Vamel Alliance, I don't think we are beneath you. But I believe you will overlook the return of the antidote we promised before."
"If it means saving that child, I'll do whatever it takes. This is something I can honestly say now..."
Owl cleared his throat as if feeling awkward.

"In fact, Yona is the youngest daughter of our Nameless Assassins, a princess, and our greatest treasure. Not just me, everyone cherishes Yona. Not just your family, maybe even more than you. Even if she loses her ability to control her life, that fact will never change."
Although it felt like a special confession, Owl and the members of Nameless Assassins always showed their vulnerability to Yona.
So everyone didn't find his words surprising, but Owl kept coughing awkwardly.
Yona didn't realize it, but her unconscious also considered Nameless Assassins as 'family'.
That's why, even while consumed by chaos, she only tried to harm her family. Because if it's not her family, she would never be able to forgive anyone when she recovers.

"There are people who feel like they've shared more blood than their own kin. For me, it was my comrades and the Myeongwang tribe brothers, and for Yona, it would be Nameless Assassins. When she comes back, it would be nice to welcome her together."
